about: Golden answers for framing geometry. framing.py generated these; framing.ts must reproduce every row (scripts/check-framing.mjs) and so must framing.py (tests/test_framing.py). If a change to the maths is intended, regenerate this file and review the diff — a changed row is a photo that will now be framed differently. Includes sizes whose scaled edge is exactly an odd integer: the only case where half-up and half-to-even rounding differ, and so the only rows that can catch a port using a language's built-in round.

columns.in: imageW, imageH, frameW, frameH, focalX, focalY, zoom
